title: Only Fits Vacuums With Round Connectors
text:
Only Fits Vacuums With Round Connectors. Before you buy this HOMESOURCE FLEX 'N SEEK CREVICE TOOL, be sure to check the shape of your vacuum's connectors. If your vacuum has square connectors (at the extension wand, hose, or motor unit), then this tool will NOT fit. It only fits vacuums with round connectors. Thus it only fits one of my three Bissell vacuums. The adapter adjusts for larger or smaller round connectors, but not for square connectors.

The crevice tool will fit into or under 1/2" wide spaces. It won't fit under my refrigerator, as I'd hoped (though that was probably an unrealistic hope). More significantly, the flexible tip isn't very flexible. The tool is bent into a curved shape by the packaging, and I'm going to have to place weights on it to straighten it out. Out of the box, it's hard to use, because the stiff curve makes it difficult to maneuver into tight spaces, and to keep the tool end flat against the floor for good suction.

Because this intriguing tool is poorly designed, and doesn't fit vacuums with square connectors, I rate it at 2 stars ("I don't like it" on the official Amazon scale).
